# Golden reference test data

Generated by `scripts/gen-golden.mjs` using pptxgenjs **v4.0.1** (dist/pptxgen.cjs.js) under Node v22.22.2.

Each subdirectory contains the extracted XML/rels/media parts of a .pptx produced by the real JS library, for byte-for-byte comparison against the Go port's output. The .pptx binaries themselves are not kept — only the extracted parts.

To regenerate: `/opt/node22/bin/node scripts/gen-golden.mjs` from the repo root (requires `npm install --omit=dev` first).

## Cases

- `01-basic/` — 20 files
- `02-text-rich/` — 20 files
- `03-shapes/` — 20 files
- `04-table/` — 20 files
- `05-chart-bar/` — 23 files
- `06-chart-multi/` — 30 files
- `07-image/` — 21 files
- `08-master/` — 22 files
